transjakarta-mikrotrans.note: Mikrotrans JakLingko gratis bagi penumpang pada 21 Oktober 2026; penumpang tetap harus tap-in dan tap-out, dan operator dibayar per jarak tempuh. Usulan tarif Rp2.000 mulai 1 Januari 2027 belum berlaku.

transjakarta-wisata.note: Bus Wisata Transjakarta beroperasi dengan tarif Rp0 atau gratis, demikian keterangan resmi operator untuk BW1, BW2 dan BW4.

integrations.label: Integrasi Multimodal (JakLingko)
integrations.note: Satu tiket untuk BRT, MRT dan LRT Jakarta, berlaku 3 jam, maksimal Rp10.000. Mikrotrans, bus non-BRT dan KRL tidak termasuk.

integrations.label: Integrasi Transjakarta (kartu JakLingko)
integrations.note: Tarif maksimal Rp5.000 untuk semua perjalanan Transjakarta dalam 3 jam, berlaku dengan kartu berlogo JakLingko. Tanpa kartu itu setiap kendaraan ditagih Rp3.500.

access.transjakarta-brt: Tap in di halte pertama dan tap out di halte tujuan. Ganti koridor di dalam halte yang sama tidak menambah tarif. Keluar halte lalu naik lagi dihitung naik baru. Tarif mengikuti jam tap in. Saldo kartu minimal Rp5.000. Tidak tap out memblokir kartu, dan tarif perjalanan ini ditarik pada tap in berikutnya.
access.transjakarta-non-brt: Tap in dan tap out di mesin di dalam bus. Setiap kali naik bus ditagih sendiri, termasuk ganti dari koridor BRT. Tarif mengikuti jam tap in. Saldo kartu minimal Rp5.000. Tidak tap out memblokir kartu.
access.mrt-jakarta: Tap in di stasiun masuk dan tap out di stasiun keluar. Ganti peron di dalam stasiun yang sama tetap satu tarif. Tarif naik Rp1.000 untuk setiap stasiun setelah stasiun pertama, sampai Rp14.000. Kartu Multi Trip harus berisi minimal Rp14.000.
access.lrt-jakarta: Tap in di stasiun masuk dan tap out di stasiun keluar. Ganti kereta di dalam area berbayar tetap satu tarif Rp5.000. Berada di area berbayar lebih dari 2 jam tanpa tap out dikenai Rp5.000. Saldo kartu minimal Rp5.000 menurut FAQ operator.
access.lrt-jabodebek: Tap in di stasiun masuk dan tap out di stasiun keluar. Ganti jalur di dalam stasiun yang sama tetap satu tarif menurut jarak dari masuk sampai keluar. Tarif di luar skema JakLingko, jadi pindah moda ditagih terpisah. Saldo kartu minimal Rp10.000.
access.krl-jabodetabek: Tap in di stasiun masuk dan tap out di stasiun keluar. Ganti jalur di dalam stasiun yang sama tetap satu tiket. Tarif KRL tidak masuk skema JakLingko, jadi pindah moda ditagih terpisah. Saldo Kartu Multi Trip minimal Rp5.000.
access.transjakarta-mikrotrans: Gratis bagi penumpang. Tap in dan tap out di dalam bus tetap wajib.
access.transjakarta-royaltrans: Royaltrans di luar setiap skema integrasi. Bayar dengan kartu elektronik atau QRIS Tap di dalam bus.

withheld.transjakarta-rumah-susun: Layanan bus ke hunian rusun memakai tarif reguler Transjakarta, Rp3.500; penghuni rusun termasuk salah satu kelompok yang mendapat tarif gratis.

notes: Data compiled 2026-10-20 (Jakarta time) from primary sources: transjakarta.co.id (official PT Transportasi Jakarta site, including the official per-route 'peta rute' images at smk.transjakarta.co.id/aset/berkas/rute/), id.wikipedia.org articles 'Transjakarta', 'Mikrotrans', 'Layanan pengumpan dalam kota (Transjakarta)' and the per-corridor articles 'Koridor N Transjakarta', and OpenStreetMap via the Overpass API.

BRT: 14 trunk corridors (1-14) plus 16 cross-corridor / express variants (2A, 3F, 3H, 4D, 5C, 6A, 6B, 6V, 7F, 9A, 9C, 9N, 10H, 13B, 13E, L13E) = 30 routes currently published on transjakarta.co.id/layanan/brt. There is NO corridor 15, 16, 17 or 18 in service: id.wikipedia.org/wiki/Koridor_15_Transjakarta is a redirect to the main Transjakarta article and corridors 16-18 have no article at all.

Corridor names, halte (stop) names and stop ORDER for all 30 BRT routes were transcribed from the official route maps linked from transjakarta.co.id/layanan/brt. Each map carries an 'Informasi per <date>' stamp (the maps range from 2024-12-12 to 2026-10-06), so they reflect the current line-up but individual maps are not all the same vintage.

lengthKm is populated only for the 14 trunk corridors, using the 'Koridor Utama' summary table in id.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transjakarta. The per-corridor Wikipedia infoboxes sometimes give a different figure (notably corridor 9: 31.57 km in the summary table vs 28.8 km in the infobox; corridor 12: 23.30 vs 18.85; corridor 11: 13.86 vs 15.0; corridor 5: 13.58 vs 13.53). Both values are recorded in lengthKmNote. Lengths for cross-corridor variants (2A, 3F, ...) are null because no verified published figure was found.

Station coordinates are decimal degrees WGS84 taken from OpenStreetMap (Overpass API, relations with network=Transjakarta). Coordinates are null where the OSM stop name did not match the official map name. OSM stop lists are sometimes shorter than the official map list (e.g. OSM corridor 1 has 22 stop nodes vs 22 halte on the official map), so the official name list is authoritative for ordering and OSM is only used for geocoding.

'operator' on BRT corridors is derived from the 'Operator koridor dan armada bus' list in id.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transjakarta, which attributes corridors to 8 companies: PT Transportasi Jakarta (swakelola), Mayasari Bakti (MB/MYS), Perum DAMRI (DMR), Steady Safe (SAF), Bianglala Metropolitan (BMP), Pahala Kencana (PKT), Koantas Bima (KBM), Bayu Holong Persada (BHL/MBT), Jewa Dian Mitra (JDM), Sinar Jaya (SJM), Pusaka Satria Utama / Bluebird (PSU) and Sentra Glosia Indonesia (SGI). The wiki list also names several routes that are no longer published on the official site (e.g. 4H, 4M, L4, 5D, 5E, 5H, 5K, 7M, L7, 9M, 9K, 11V, 12M, L10, L6, 1N, 1V, 1K, 1T, 2F, 3C, 11C, 11M, 12C, 12F) so it is NOT a complete or fully current picture of the operator split.

MINITRANS: the term is not used by transjakarta.co.id. The official website groups every non-BRT route under 'Angkutan Pengumpan' and separately publishes 'Mikrotrans'. 'MiniTrans' is the medium-bus (bus sedang) sub-class of the non-BRT feeder fleet. Per id.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transjakarta the medium buses are operated by Trans Swadaya, Jewa Dian Mitra, Bayu Holong Persada, Pusaka Satria Utama (Bluebird) and Sentra Glosia Indonesia 'as MiniTrans', while the large buses are 'MetroTrans' (Mayasari Bakti, PT Transjakarta swakelola, Bianglala Metropolitan, Perum DAMRI) and the small buses are 'Mikrotrans'. Media usage is inconsistent: some outlets use 'Minitrans' as a synonym for any small feeder bus. The transjakarta-minitrans system here lists the non-BRT routes that Wikipedia attributes to the medium-bus operators; the operator field for each route is derived from that attribution and is therefore indicative, not an official PT Transjakarta publication.

MIKROTRANS: 99 routes currently published on transjakarta.co.id/layanan/mikrotrans, coded JAK.01-JAK.120 plus lettered variants (JAK03, JAK10A, JAK10B, JAK43B, JAK43C, JAK48A, JAK78A, JAK78B, JAK98, JAK105-JAK108, JAK110A, JAK110B, JAK112, JAK113, JAK115, JAK117, JAK118, JAK120 etc.). They are operated by cooperatives: Koperasi Wahana Kendaraan Angkutan Lingkungan dan Pinggir Kota (KWK), Pusat Koperasi Angkutan Udara Halim Perdanakusuma (PUS) and the Mikrolet / APB (Angkutan Pengganti Bemo) group (PT Kencana Sakti Transport, Koperasi Mikrolet Jakarta Raya, Koperasi Angkutan Umum Budi Luhur, Koperasi Minibus Karya Jakarta Raya, Koperasi Angkutan Umum Kopamilet Jaya, Koperasi Angkutan Purimas Jaya, PT Lestari Surya Gema Persada, Koperasi Kojang Jaya, Koperasi Angkutan Layanan Masyarakat Jakarta Raya).

'JAKPRO' and 'JRegular' could NOT be verified as Transjakarta service-class names. Neither string appears in id.wikipedia.org's Transjakarta, Mikrotrans or 'Layanan pengumpan dalam kota' articles, nor on transjakarta.co.id. 'JAKPRO' in Indonesian transit usage normally refers to the Jabodetabek regulator / its Transjabodetabek (cross-province) bus routes (B11, B21, D11, P11, S11, S21, T11 etc.), which are a different, TransJabodetabek-administered network. The current official term for the non-BRT in-city routes is 'Angkutan Pengumpan'.

OFFICIAL API: https://api.transjakarta.co.id resolves (A record 103.145.125.20) but the host refused every TCP connection tested on ports 80, 443, 8080 and 3000 at the time of testing, from both curl and an HTTP fetch tool. No working response shape could therefore be captured for /v3/bus, /v3/routes, /v3/stops or /v3/health. The API is therefore recorded as UNREACHABLE / UNVERIFIED here - do not hard-code a response schema from memory.

GTFS: https://gtfs.transjakarta.co.id/ resolves (103.145.125.115) and returns HTTP 200, but it is NOT a public GTFS download. It serves a login page titled 'Login | Upload File GTFS' (Sistem Manajemen Konten, CMS) with NIK + password fields. /gtfs.zip, /transjakarta.zip and /api all return HTTP 404. A public GTFS feed could not be located.

FARES (id.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transjakarta, 'Tarif'): Rp2,000 flat for 05:00-07:00 WIB ('Layanan Ekonomi'), Rp3,500 flat for 07:00-23:59 and 00:01-04:59 WIB ('Layanan Reguler'), determined by tap-in time. Two integration schemes: OKOTRIP (JakLingko co-brand KUE, max Rp5,000 within 3 hours across Transjakarta BRT/NBRT) and Integrasi Multimoda (account-based e-ticketing across MRT Jakarta + LRT Jakarta + Transjakarta, max Rp10,000 within 3 hours, then Rp250/km per subsequent mode). KLG (Kartu Layanan Gratis) is the free-travel card.
